neckEase.name: Neck ease (%)
neckEase.help: Controls how large the neck hole is.

chestEase.name: Chest ease (%)
chestEase.help: Controls how wide the shirt will be at your chest.

armpitEase.name: Armpit ease (%)
armpitEase.help: Gives more room in the armpit by shifting the sleeve down the body.

neckBalance.name: Neck position (%)
neckBalance.help: Controls where the neck hole is placed on the shirt.

sleeveEase.name: Sleeve ease (%)
sleeveEase.help: Affects how wide the sleeve is at the armhole on all shirts, and has some affect on the width at the hem of short sleeved shirts.

wristEase.name: Wrist ease (%)
wristEase.help: Affects how wide the end of the sleeve is on sleeves that extend past the biceps. The effect is greater on longer sleeves.

neckbandLength.name: Neckband length (%)
neckbandLength.help: Controls how long the neckband is, as a percentage of the circumference of the neckline.

neckbandWidth.name: Neckband width (%)
neckbandWidth.help: Controls how wide the finished neckband will be, as a percentage of the neckline circumference.

bodyLength.name: Body length (%)
bodyLength.help: Controls how long the shirt is.

sleeveLength.name: Sleeve length (%)
sleeveLength.help: Controls the how long the sleeves of your shirt will be.

straightSides.name: Straight Sides
straightSides.help: Forms a tubular shirt, which is a shirt where the hips and chest are the same width and connected by a straight seam.

hipsEase.name: Hips ease (%)
hipsEase.help: Controls how wide your shirt will be at the bottom hem. This option is only used if the straight sides option is disabled.

raglanScoopLength.name: Raglan scoop length (%)
raglanScoopLength.help: Controls how far out from the armhole the raglan seam starts to scoop.

raglanScoopMagnitude.name: Raglan scoop depth (%)
raglanScoopMagnitude.help: Controls how much extra material to place under the armpits.

sideShape.name: Body shape (%)
sideShape.help: Controls how the side seam is curved. This option is ignored if the straight sides option is enabled.

hemWidth.name: Hem width (%)
hemWidth.help: Sets the hem allowance along the bottom of the body of the shirt, as a multiple of the seam allowance.

sleeveHem.name: Sleeve hem (%)
sleeveHem.help: Sets the hem allowance of the hem along the end of the sleeves, as a multiple of the seam allowance.
